name: DeFi Index
status: in force since 2026-09-16 — rules-only paper index, no vault; inception anchored (see decisions.jsonl)

universe.sourcePair: CoinGecko category `decentralized-finance-defi` INTERSECT DefiLlama protocol listing whose category is DeFi-family
universe.chainsOut: tokens with a DefiLlama Chain listing (native gas token of a chain: INJ, GNO, SEI, TRX, BNB, ETH, SOL, AVAX, ...) are excluded -- a chain is infrastructure, not a sector
universe.oraclesIn: oracle tokens (LINK, PYTH, ...) are DeFi-family per CoinGecko/CMC/DefiLlama and are explicitly INCLUDED (owner 2026-09-15: "follow the data")
universe.instrumentExclusions: qX20 rulebook §3 categories in full (stablecoins, yield-bearing stables, wrapped assets, LSD/LRT wrapper tokens, LP/vault shares, exchange tokens, tokenized RWA shares) plus qDEFI-specific: one-token-per-protocol (staked derivative excluded when the underlying governance token is already a member, e.g. stkAAVE/sENA out because AAVE/ENA are in)

rankBuffer.note: 0.85N / 1.15N per qdefi.md §6 -- an incumbent is kept while rank <= exitMinRank, an outsider is force-added only at rank <= entryMaxRank, seats filled to targetCount by best remaining rank

exitHysteresis.note: qdefi.md has no hysteresis rule beyond the rank buffer itself -- a name failing eligibility or falling below exitMinRank exits at that reconstitution, no grace quarter

cap.method: immediate trim to cap at reconstitution, excess redistributed pro rata among uncapped names, iterated to convergence

reconstitution.rule: first run after 00:00 UTC on Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1 (same dates as qREV)

tolerance.rule: a name whose target weight differs from its drifted (mark-to-market) weight by less than 5 percentage points is NOT traded at reconstitution
tolerance.capOverride: any name whose drifted weight is above 35% is ALWAYS cut to 35% regardless of the 5-point tolerance

reconstitution.betweenReconstitutions: no trading; the book is only marked to market daily. No drift band (owner 2026-09-15).

specialEvents.note: token migrations (e.g. MKR->SKY-style rebrands), hacks, delistings, and other special events are OUT OF SCOPE for this paper-index implementation pass.

sectorClassification.secondary: DefiLlama protocols list (category field + gecko_id/symbol match)
sectorClassification.fallback: none -- if either source is unreachable, membership is frozen at the last reconstitution

basket._doc: The on-chain basket for this index (QuadrixBasketVault v3.1 on GIWA Sepolia). vault/faucet null = not deployed: the keeper computes every mark and posts none. After a deploy (site repo .github/workflows/deploy-index-basket.yml) fill vault, faucet, assets {SYMBOL: {address, decimals}} in manifest order, and navBase = the index level on the deploy day (contracts/baskets/{index}.json navBase), so the first post is navPerShare 1.000000. keeper/basket-mark.mjs reads this block.
